name: Roasted Chicken Breast & Sour Cream Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Tender roasted chicken breast atop smooth, peeled mashed potatoes and fork-soft roasted root carrots is one of the gentlest main dining meals onboard.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If you have a strict citrus guardrail, ask for the plain "Lighter Note" roasted chicken breast paired with the sour cream mashed potatoes, and hold the whole-grain mustard jus.
watchOuts: Lemon-thyme marinade (citrus guardrail — request plain roasted breast)
Whole mustard seeds in the jus
Sour cream in mashed potatoes if lactose sensitive
